## Parameters

Edit this block, then re-render (`Ctrl+Shift+K`).

```{r params}
# Which head? — always required, sets modem, n_nodes, type, spacing -----------
HEAD_ID <- "test"  # "test" | "26-02" | "26-03" | "26-04" | "26-05"

# Paste hex payload(s) from email ---------------------------------------------
# SnowMelt heads (26-02, 26-03): one message  → fill MSG1, leave MSG2 = ""
# Other heads    (26-04, 26-05): one message  → fill MSG1, leave MSG2 = ""
# If the head sends two messages per measurement, paste both.
MSG1 <- ""
MSG2 <- ""

# OR: path to .bin attachment from the Cloudloop email (overrides MSG1/MSG2) -
# Format: 4-byte timestamp + [0x7C | 3-byte value] × N + [0x7C | 2-byte battery]
# Modem / n_nodes / spacing come from head_config[[HEAD_ID]], not the file.
BIN_FILE <- "../testdata/301434062008130-138.bin"
```

```{r head-config}
head_config <- list(
  "test" = list(modem = 9999L, n_nodes = 3L,
                 fields = c("ntc1", "ntc2", "testSB"),
                 type = "snowmelt", spacing_cm = 4L),
  "26-02" = list(modem = 228680L, n_nodes = 24L,
                 fields = c("ntc1", "ntc2", "testSB"),
                 type = "snowmelt", spacing_cm = 4L),
  "26-03" = list(modem = 234047L, n_nodes = 24L,
                 fields = c("ntc1", "ntc2", "testSB"),
                 type = "snowmelt", spacing_cm = 4L),
  "26-04" = list(modem = 234048L, n_nodes = 20L,
                 fields = c("ntc1", "ntc2", "gnd"),
                 type = "standard", spacing_cm = NA_integer_),
  "26-05" = list(modem = 228679L, n_nodes = 20L,
                 fields = c("ntc1", "ntc2", "gnd"),
                 type = "standard", spacing_cm = NA_integer_)
)

cfg     <- head_config[[HEAD_ID]]
n_nodes <- cfg$n_nodes
fields  <- cfg$fields

if (BIN_FILE == "") {
  n_hex_node   <- sum(ifelse(fields %in% c("ntc1", "ntc2", "testSB"), 6L, 4L))
  expected_hex <- 8L + 6L + n_nodes * n_hex_node + 4L
} else {
  n_file     <- file.info(BIN_FILE)$size
  n_detected <- (n_file - 11L) %/% 12L
  if (n_detected != n_nodes)
    warning(sprintf("File implies %d nodes but Head_%s config has %d — check HEAD_ID",
                    n_detected, HEAD_ID, n_nodes))
}
```

## Decode functions

```{r decode-fns}
hex_to_uint <- function(h) {
  if (is.na(h) || nchar(h) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  chars  <- strsplit(toupper(h), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  nibble <- match(chars, c(as.character(0:9), LETTERS[1:6])) - 1L
  if (any(is.na(nibble))) return(NA_real_)
  v <- 0; for (d in nibble) v <- v * 16 + d; v
}

hex_to_int <- function(h, bits) {
  v <- hex_to_uint(h)
  if (is.na(v)) return(NA_integer_)
  s <- 2^(bits - 1L)
  if (v >= s) v <- v - 2^bits
  as.integer(v)
}

field_spec <- function(name) {
  if (name == "time_unix")  return(list(n = 8L, fn = hex_to_uint))
  if (name == "adc_temp")   return(list(n = 6L, fn = function(h) hex_to_int(h, 24L)))
  if (name == "battery_mv") return(list(n = 4L, fn = hex_to_uint))
  if (grepl("\\.(ntc1|ntc2|testSB)$", name))
    return(list(n = 6L, fn = function(h) hex_to_int(h, 24L)))
  if (grepl("\\.gnd$", name))
    return(list(n = 4L, fn = function(h) hex_to_int(h, 16L)))
  stop("Unknown field: ", name)
}

build_schema <- function(n_nodes, fields) {
  node_fields <- paste(
    sapply(seq_len(n_nodes), function(i)
      paste(paste0("n", i, ".", fields), collapse = " ")),
    collapse = " "
  )
  paste("time_unix adc_temp", node_fields, "battery_mv")
}

decode_hex <- function(schema, hex) {
  fnames <- strsplit(trimws(schema), "\\s+")[[1]]
  pos    <- 1L
  out    <- setNames(vector("list", length(fnames)), fnames)
  for (i in seq_along(fnames)) {
    sp      <- field_spec(fnames[i])
    block   <- substr(hex, pos, pos + sp$n - 1L)
    out[[i]] <- if (nchar(block) == sp$n) sp$fn(block) else NA
    pos <- pos + sp$n
  }
  out
}

adc2temp       <- function(c) 6.101e-5 * c - 256.6
NTCcounts2temp <- function(c) {
  H <- (-c * 1e6) / (c - 33554432)
  r <- (H * 499000) / (499000 - H)
  1 / ((1 / 3380) * log(r / 10000) + 1 / 298.15) - 273.15
}
pressure2hPa   <- function(p) p / 1000
unix2utc       <- function(t) as.POSIXct(t, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")

# Binary snowchain decoder: 4-byte timestamp + [0x7C | value]* + [0x7C | uint16 battery]
# Each sensor value is a 3-byte big-endian signed int24, preceded by 0x7C.
# Battery is a 2-byte big-endian uint16, preceded by 0x7C.
# Expected file size: 11 + 12 * n_nodes (validated against head_config).
read_snowchain_bin <- function(path) {
  raw   <- readBin(path, what = "raw", n = file.info(path)$size)
  n     <- length(raw)
  if ((n - 11L) %% 12L != 0L)
    stop(sprintf("Unexpected file size %d B — expected 11 + 12×N bytes", n))
  n_nd  <- (n - 11L) %/% 12L

  be_uint32 <- function(b) sum(as.integer(b) * c(16777216, 65536, 256, 1))
  be_int24  <- function(b) {
    v <- sum(as.integer(b) * c(65536L, 256L, 1L))
    if (v >= 8388608L) v - 16777216L else as.integer(v)
  }
  be_uint16 <- function(b) sum(as.integer(b) * c(256, 1))

  time_unix <- be_uint32(raw[1:4])
  pos <- 5L

  read3 <- function() {
    if (as.integer(raw[pos]) != 0x7CL)
      warning(sprintf("Expected 0x7C at byte %d, got 0x%02X", pos, as.integer(raw[pos])))
    v <- be_int24(raw[(pos + 1L):(pos + 3L)])
    pos <<- pos + 4L; v
  }
  read2 <- function() {
    if (as.integer(raw[pos]) != 0x7CL)
      warning(sprintf("Expected 0x7C at byte %d, got 0x%02X", pos, as.integer(raw[pos])))
    v <- be_uint16(raw[(pos + 1L):(pos + 2L)])
    pos <<- pos + 3L; v
  }

  adc_temp   <- read3()
  nodes_raw  <- lapply(seq_len(n_nd), function(i)
    list(ntc1 = read3(), ntc2 = read3(), testSB = read3()))
  battery_mv <- read2()

  list(time_unix = time_unix, adc_temp = adc_temp,
       nodes = nodes_raw, battery_mv = as.integer(battery_mv),
       n_nodes = n_nd)
}
```

## Decode

```{r decode}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

if (BIN_FILE != "") {
  # ---- Binary snowchain path ------------------------------------------------
  bin        <- read_snowchain_bin(BIN_FILE)
  time_utc   <- unix2utc(bin$time_unix)
  adc_temp_C <- adc2temp(bin$adc_temp)
  battery_mv <- bin$battery_mv

  nodes <- data.frame(node = seq_len(n_nodes))
  nodes$ntc1_C   <- sapply(bin$nodes, function(nd) NTCcounts2temp(nd$ntc1))
  nodes$ntc2_C   <- sapply(bin$nodes, function(nd) NTCcounts2temp(nd$ntc2))
  nodes$testSB_C <- sapply(bin$nodes, function(nd) NTCcounts2temp(nd$testSB))

} else {
  # ---- Hex email path -------------------------------------------------------
  hex <- toupper(trimws(paste0(MSG1, MSG2)))

  if (nchar(hex) == 0) {
    cat("No payload — set BIN_FILE or paste hex into MSG1 / MSG2 above and re-render.\n")
    knitr::knit_exit()
  }

  if (nchar(hex) != expected_hex) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "Expected %d hex chars (%d bytes) for Head_%s, got %d. Payload may be incomplete.",
      expected_hex, expected_hex %/% 2L, HEAD_ID, nchar(hex)
    ))
  }

  schema <- build_schema(n_nodes, fields)
  raw    <- decode_hex(schema, hex)

  time_utc   <- unix2utc(raw$time_unix)
  adc_temp_C <- adc2temp(raw$adc_temp)
  battery_mv <- as.integer(raw$battery_mv)
}
```

## Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
check <- function(val, lo, hi, label, unit) {
  ok  <- !is.na(val) && val >= lo && val <= hi
  col <- if (ok) "#2ecc71" else "#e74c3c"
  tag <- if (ok) "OK" else "CHECK"
  cat(sprintf('<span style="color:%s">%s</span>  **%s**: %.1f %s  *(expected %g – %g)*\n\n',
              col, tag, label, val, unit, lo, hi))
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Message summary — Head_`r HEAD_ID` (modem `r cfg$modem`)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Time (UTC)** | `r format(time_utc, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")` |
| **Battery** | `r battery_mv` mV |
| **ADC temp** | `r round(adc_temp_C, 2)` °C |
| **Source** | `r if (BIN_FILE != "") paste0("binary: ", basename(BIN_FILE)) else paste0("hex: ", nchar(hex), " chars / ", nchar(hex) %/% 2, " bytes")` |
:::

```{r diag-checks, results='asis'}
check(battery_mv,  5500, 7200, "Battery",  "mV")
check(adc_temp_C, -60,   40,   "ADC temp", "°C")
```

## Node data

```{r node-table}
if (BIN_FILE == "") {
  # Build nodes dataframe from hex-decoded raw list
  ntc_fields <- fields[fields != "gnd"]
  gnd_field  <- if ("gnd" %in% fields) "gnd" else NULL

  nodes <- data.frame(node = seq_len(n_nodes))

  for (f in ntc_fields) {
    col_raw  <- paste0("n", nodes$node, ".", f)
    col_name <- paste0(f, "_C")
    nodes[[col_name]] <- sapply(col_raw, function(nm) NTCcounts2temp(raw[[nm]]))
  }

  if (!is.null(gnd_field)) {
    col_raw <- paste0("n", nodes$node, ".gnd")
    nodes$gnd <- sapply(col_raw, function(nm) raw[[nm]])
  }

}

src_label <- if (BIN_FILE != "") basename(BIN_FILE) else paste0("Head_", HEAD_ID)
knitr::kable(nodes, digits = 2,
             caption = sprintf("All nodes — %s | %s UTC",
                               src_label, format(time_utc, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))
```

## Plots

```{r plot-snowmelt, eval=(cfg$type == "snowmelt"), fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
# NTC rank within node: NTC1=1, NTC2=2, TestSB=3; height = (node-1)*3*s + rank*s
s <- cfg$spacing_cm
long <- nodes |>
  select(node, ends_with("_C")) |>
  pivot_longer(ends_with("_C"), names_to = "sensor", values_to = "temp_C") |>
  mutate(
    sensor   = recode(sensor, ntc1_C = "NTC1", ntc2_C = "NTC2", testSB_C = "NTC3 (TestSB)"),
    ntc_rank = case_when(sensor == "NTC1" ~ 1L, sensor == "NTC2" ~ 2L, TRUE ~ 3L),
    hoehe_cm = (node - 1L) * 3L * s + ntc_rank * s
  )

max_h <- n_nodes * 3L * s
ggplot(long, aes(x = temp_C, y = hoehe_cm)) +
  geom_path(data = arrange(long, hoehe_cm), colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = sensor, shape = sensor), size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Höhe (cm)",
    limits = c(0, max_h),
    breaks = seq(0, max_h, by = max(s, 8L))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Temperatur (°C)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(NTC1 = "#2980b9", NTC2 = "#e74c3c",
                                 "NTC3 (TestSB)" = "#27ae60")) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Temperaturprofil — Head_%s", HEAD_ID),
    subtitle = sprintf("%s UTC  |  Modem %d", format(time_utc, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), cfg$modem),
    colour   = NULL, shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r plot-standard, eval=(cfg$type == "standard"), fig.height=6}
long_ntc <- nodes |>
  select(node, ends_with("_C")) |>
  pivot_longer(ends_with("_C"), names_to = "sensor", values_to = "temp_C") |>
  mutate(sensor = recode(sensor, ntc1_C = "NTC1", ntc2_C = "NTC2"))

p1 <- ggplot(long_ntc, aes(x = node, y = temp_C, colour = sensor)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(NTC1 = "#2980b9", NTC2 = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(title = sprintf("Temperatures — Head_%s", HEAD_ID),
       subtitle = sprintf("%s UTC  |  modem %d",
                          format(time_utc, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), cfg$modem),
       x = "Node", y = "Temperature (°C)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p2 <- ggplot(nodes, aes(x = node, y = gnd)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#7f8c8d", width = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Node", y = "GND (counts)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)

p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
```

outfile <- sprintf("data/decoded_%s_%s.csv", slug, format(time_utc, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
write.csv(nodes, outfile, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved:", outfile, "\n")
